result.instructions: Tools for ThinkReservations, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which reservations arrive at our property next week?"; "How many units of each room type are still open in December?"; "What would a 3-night stay for 2 adults cost next month, with fees and taxes?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ThinkReservations data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run thinkreservations_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run thinkreservations_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run thinkreservations_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. thinkreservations_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: thinkreservations_get_hotel
tools.description: Get the basic details of the property (hotel) the API key is bound to. Needs scope read:hotel.

tools.name: thinkreservations_list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms of the property: name, description, room type and whether the room is active. Needs scope read:room.

tools.name: thinkreservations_list_room_types
tools.description: List the room types (name and id). Use the ids to filter inventory and daily rates. Needs scope read:room.

tools.name: thinkreservations_list_rate_types
tools.description: List the rate types the property offers, with their policies. Needs scope read:rate.

tools.name: thinkreservations_get_rate_type
tools.description: Get one rate type and its policies by id. Needs scope read:rate.

tools.name: thinkreservations_get_daily_rates
tools.description: Get the day-by-day price, minimum-stay rules and closed-to-arrival restrictions of one rate type for a date range. Needs scope read:rate.

tools.name: thinkreservations_list_promotions
tools.description: List the promotions configured for the property. Needs scope read:rate.

tools.name: thinkreservations_list_reservations
tools.description: List reservations (paged). Filter by stay dates, creation time or last-modified time (give at least one filter). Guest contact details appear only if the key has scope read:customer; otherwise customer is null. Needs scope read:reservation.

stay_on_start_date.description: Reservations with a stay on or after this date.

stay_on_end_date.description: Reservations with a stay on or before this date.

updated_at_start_date_time.description: Last modified from this time. Use for incremental sync.

sort.description: Sort expression, as the API reference describes.

tools.name: thinkreservations_get_inventory
tools.description: Get the daily inventory (units left) per room type for a date range. Needs scope read:availability.

tools.name: thinkreservations_list_blackouts
tools.description: List the blackouts in a date range: room-specific blocked dates (room id and date pairs), not whole-property closures. Needs scope read:availability.

tools.name: thinkreservations_get_availability
tools.description: Search what the property can sell for a stay: per bookable unit, the rate types with price for the whole stay, fees, taxes, deposit and total. Read-only quote, books nothing. Needs scope read:availability.

coupon_code.description: A promotion code the hotel has published.
